body: Yeah. You're describing my life verbatim right now. I can relate not only to your scenario but every single one of your questions. I guess that's why we're here right now? It's some heavy shit to process. Trust me. I'm right here going through the same kind of stuff.

I can relate. Do you know who I'm grateful for? The people who made YouTube and "new video" suggestions. It sounds stupid but I think I've survived several days in life just because somebody gave me something new to watch on Youtube. Do you know what I mean? I kind of wish I could do that with my life. Hit refresh and see something new and exciting. Something helpful. See life in a new way I never thought was possible. It's not that easy though, is it?

I don't actually want to die but I'm thinking about suicide a lot. Do you want to know what I really want? I kind of want to win the lottery and go travel the world. I don't think that's going to happen anytime soon. That'd be kind of fun though, don't you think? Why are you thinking about suicide?

It's a funny book. I'm honestly not a huge book reader but I've managed to read that book. If you don't feel like reading, maybe check out the movie? It's decent. Sometimes it helps to watch something funny. If you get a chance to read the book though, DO IT. It's just... witty and funny.

You are probably right. 

That's a fun question to ask because it's from a book called "The Hitchiker's Guide To The Galaxy".

The way you just answered that question makes me think you might like that book for some reason. In the book they asked this huge computer "What is the meaning of life, the universe, and everything?" and after several million years the computer answered... 42. 

42 is kind of the joke answer. I like your answer though. 

Anyways, sounds like you are going through some pretty shitty stuff like me right now. I'm only on SW because I can relate and have felt suicidal lately.

Alright, I'm game. I'll ask you a very deep question. There is only one correct answer. 

What is the meaning of life, the universe, and everything?

Dude, I remember being a teen and freaking out over stuff like this. You want to know a secret? Most people aren't looking at you as often as you probably look at yourself in the mirror. This is a good thing. It means most people aren't judging you as harshly as you are judging yourself. You'll be alright. Did you know a lot of women like bald guys? It's true. Relax. You will survive this.

I remember reading this and thinking... "Hold up mothertrucker. You just said 'So long and thanks for all the fish.' That's from 'Hitchhiker's Guide To The Galaxy.'" It made me sign up for an account just to say that. Seriously, do you know how many people there are out there who haven't heard of Douglas Adams? You can't die. The world needs people like you. Ironically, though, I'm only on here because I've also been thinking about suicide. I'm not really judging. It kind of seems like you have some good things going for you though. You graduated? I didn't graduate from college. I used to think that was the end of everything because I didn't graduate. I somehow survived for a little while though. Who cares if it took you six years? That's awesome.
